These are ordinary commercial disputes, not regulatory or criminal proceedings; per project rules they are not rejection grounds and are recorded neutrally. No evidence found of any regulator action (SEBI/RBI/DGFT/ED/CCI) or negative press coverage; searches for news returned no relevant results, so news_risk = null (not public / not found, not asserted as clean). Russia/CIS supply: no evidence found — Indian Kanoon search for 'Sahastraa Exports Russia' returned no matching results, and no customs, B-L or open-source record linking the company to Russian or CIS counterparties was located; rf_supply = null means 'no evidence found', not 'confirmed absent'. Research limitation: the primary web_search backend was unavailable (connection refused) and Bing returned irrelevant results for most queries, so coverage of news and regulator sources is incomplete; findings rest mainly on Indian Kanoon and OpenSanctions. Legal identity, HS code and shipment volumes were out of scope for this role and were not assessed.
